irritool

The goal of irritool is to provide practical tools and workflows for irrigation engineering, crop water requirements, soil water balance, and hydraulic calculations.

Installation

You can install the development version of irritool from GitHub with:

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("joaobtj/irritool")

Overview

The package is being redesigned to focus on irrigation scheduling and hydraulics.

Documentation

For detailed function references, mathematical background, and tutorials (in English and Portuguese), visit the package website:

👉 https://joaobtj.github.io/irritool/
